name: Intel QUEENCREEK task (Intel SUR)
description: Intel's System Usage Report task (Intel Driver & Support Assistant / Computing Improvement Program): USER_ESRV_SVC_QUEENCREEK runs wscript with task.vbs from C:\Program Files\Intel\SUR\QUEENCREEK. Not malware, but it collects usage data; matched exactly (name, path and arguments), anything else of the kind stays a suspicious startup item.
remediation: Nothing to do if Intel software is wanted on the device; to stop the telemetry, uninstall Intel Computing Improvement Program / the SUR component or disable the task.
